description: An extension a stack uses, and the resource types it defines.

digest.description: The sha256 digest of the extension's bundle. Every loader checks the bundle against it.

name.description: The extension's name, the first part of each type it defines, such as "acme".

resourceTypes.description: The resource types the extension defines, keyed by type name, such as "acme/dns-zone".

additionalProperties.description: What Alien knows about a resource type an extension defines.

controllerPlatforms.description: The platforms the extension ships a controller for this type on.

holdsData.description:
Whether deleting the resource can lose the customer's data. Removing a deployment keeps
such a resource unless the deletion erases data.

items.description: Describes the lifecycle of a resource within a stack, determining how it's managed and deployed.

lifecycles.description: The lifecycles a resource of this type may have.

link.description: What a workload that links a resource of this type gets.

permissionSets.description: Ids of the permission sets the workload gets on the linked resource.

items.description: A permission set that can be applied across different cloud platforms

description.description: Human-readable description of what this permission set allows

id.description: Unique identifier for the permission set (e.g., "storage/data-read")

binding.description: How to bind the permissions (stack vs resource scope)

additionalProperties.description: An IAM condition accepts one string or a list of alternative string values.

notResources.description:
ARN patterns rendered as IAM `NotResource`, in place of `resources`. Its one use is a
tag-on-create grant whose implied check AWS authorizes against no resource; the build
refuses it anywhere else.

description.description: Short admin-facing description of why this entry exists.

permissions.description: GCP permissions that require an exact residual custom role.

predefinedRoles.description: Provider predefined roles to bind directly.

residualPermissions.description: GCP residual custom permissions to pair with predefined roles.

label.description: Stable admin-facing label for this permission entry.

permissionSets.description:
The permission sets the extension defines for this type. Their ids are
`<extension>/<type>/<name>`.

requiresNetwork.description:
Whether the type needs the stack's network. Alien then creates the network on AWS, GCP
and Azure.

schemas.description: The JSON schemas of the type's config and outputs.

config.description: The schema of the resource's config.

outputs.description: The schema of the resource's outputs.

services.description:
The cloud services the type needs enabled, per platform: GCP APIs such as
"dns.googleapis.com", Azure resource providers such as "Microsoft.Network". Alien enables
them with the services its own resource types need.

setup.description: The setup templates and importers the extension provides for this type.

importers.description: Platforms with an importer, which reads a resource a setup template created.
